title: 第5章 效率大涨第6章 信息封锁
slug: 游戏入侵开局挖掌天瓶
content_zh:
死矿道深处，连一丝自然光都透不进来。
只有一截插在岩缝里的劣质火把，勉强照亮方圆两米的区域。火光跳跃，将苏寒的影子拉得扭曲而庞大。
“当！”
精钢鹤嘴镐撕裂暗红色的岩层。火星四溅。
一块重达三斤的高纯度赤铁矿应声砸落在地，扬起一阵刺鼻的粉尘。
苏寒双手紧握由铁木打造的镐柄。精钢鹤嘴镐附加的2点力量，与他自身的7点力量完美叠加。9点力量在肌肉纤维中奔涌，带来一种撕裂一切的错觉。
这把在铁匠眼中重达三十斤的“废件”，在苏寒手里，轻盈得只是一根加长版的柴火棍。
一镐落下，岩壁上直接崩出一个拳头大小的深坑。
冰凉的经验气流顺着木柄，疯狂倒灌进苏寒的掌心。
气流的浓度和粗壮程度，是使用普通铁镐时的三倍以上。它们如同一群细小的游鱼，钻入经脉，在四肢百骸中巡游。乳酸刚刚在肱二头肌内堆积，就被这股清凉的气流强行冲刷、瓦解。肌肉纤维在细微的撕裂与修复中，变得愈发坚韧。
【叮！经验值+15】
淡蓝色的光幕在视网膜边缘一闪而逝。苏寒的目光没有半分偏移，双臂已经再次抡起铁镐。这种枯燥到足以逼疯正常人的劳作，他甘之如饴。每一丝经验值的跳动，都是他在这个世界活下去的筹码。
他不需要休息。不需要饮水。
整整五个时辰，苏寒保持着恒定的发力频率。每一次挥击的角度、落点，都经过大脑的精密计算，确保剥落最大体积的矿石。
脚边的碎石堆越来越高。三个粗布兜早已经装满。
他扯下破烂的外衣，将剩下的赤铁矿全部打包，打成一个沉重的包裹。
粗略估算，今天的总产出达到了惊人的四十斤。
这是普通矿工不吃不喝干上十天的总量。效率翻了整整十倍。
苏寒收起精钢镐。他用沾满煤灰的手掌在脸上狠狠抹了两把，将原本就脏污的面容弄得更加狼狈。
他佝偻起脊背，拖着沉重的步伐，扛着那个巨大的包裹，一步步走出死矿道。

主矿道的交矿点，排着长长的队伍。
矿工们面有菜色，手里拎着可怜巴巴的一两斤矿石，等待着管事的清点。
苏寒排在队伍的末尾。他低垂着头，剧烈地喘息着，肩膀被四十斤的重物压得一颤一颤。
人群前方，矿区恶霸彪哥正靠在一根承重柱上，手里百无聊赖地抛着几枚铜板。
彪哥的右眼角余光扫到了苏寒。
他的面部肌肉抽搐了一下。右脚下意识地往后退了半步。
昨天最高监事冯远的警告，犹如一把悬在头顶的铡刀。彪哥知道，眼前这个满脑子只有挖矿的疯子，现在是冯远眼里的“极品苦力”。动他，就是动冯远的钱袋子。
彪哥狠狠啐了一口唾沫，转过头，强行移开视线，权当没看见苏寒。
交矿的队伍缓缓向前挪动。
终于轮到了苏寒。
他将三个布兜和那个用破衣服包着的大包裹，一股脑地砸在交矿的木桌上。
“砰！”
沉闷的巨响震得木桌摇晃了一下。木桌后的清点管事吓了一跳，手里的毛笔差点掉在地上。
“你他娘的轻点！想砸了老子的摊子？”管事破口大骂。
管事解开包裹，看清里面堆积如山的高品质赤铁矿时，骂声戛然而止。
他的眼睛瞪得溜圆。嘴巴微张，半天吐不出一个字。
“四十斤。全是上等红矿。”管事咽了一口唾沫，看怪物的眼神上下打量着苏寒。
content_en:
Deep in the dead mine tunnel, not even a trace of natural light can penetrate.
There was only a low-quality torch inserted into a rock crevice, which barely illuminated a two-meter-wide area. The fire light jumped, making Su Han's shadow become twisted and huge.
"Dang!"
The stainless steel pickaxe tore through the dark red rock formations. Sparks flew everywhere.
A piece of high-purity hematite weighing three kilograms fell to the ground, raising a burst of pungent dust.
Su Han held the pickaxe handle made of ironwood tightly with both hands. The 2 points of strength added to the stainless steel pickaxe perfectly stack with his own 7 points of strength. 9 points of power rush through the muscle fibers, bringing an illusion of tearing everything apart.
This "waste piece" weighing thirty kilograms in the blacksmith's eyes was as light as an extended firewood stick in Su Han's hands.
When the pickaxe fell, a deep pit the size of a fist burst out of the rock wall.
The cold air of experience flowed along the wooden handle and poured crazily into Su Han's palm.
The concentration and thickness of the airflow are more than three times that of when using an ordinary iron pickaxe. They are like a group of tiny swimming fish, burrowing into the meridians and swimming among the limbs and bones. As soon as lactic acid accumulated in the biceps, it was forcibly washed away and disintegrated by this cool airflow. Muscle fibers become stronger and tougher through subtle tears and repairs.
【bite! Experience value +15]
A light blue curtain of light flashed past the edge of the retina. Su Han's eyes didn't shift even a little bit, and his arms were already swinging the pickaxe again. He enjoys this kind of work that is boring enough to drive normal people crazy. Every beat of experience is a bargaining chip for him to survive in this world.
He doesn't need rest. No need to drink water.
For five whole hours, Su Han maintained a constant frequency of force exertion. The angle and impact point of each swing are carefully calculated by the brain to ensure that the maximum volume of ore is peeled off.
The pile of rubble at my feet was getting higher and higher. The three coarse cloth pockets were already full.
He tore off his tattered coat and packed all the remaining hematite into a heavy package.
According to a rough estimate, today's total output reached an astonishing forty pounds.
This is the amount that an average miner would need to go without eating or drinking for ten days. The efficiency has increased tenfold.
Su Han put away the stainless steel pickaxe. He wiped his face hard twice with his soot-stained palms, making his already dirty face even more embarrassed.
He hunched his back, dragged his heavy steps, and walked out of the dead mine tunnel step by step, carrying the huge package.
There is a long queue at the intersection of the main mine tunnel.
The miners were full of food, holding a pitiful one or two kilograms of ore in their hands, waiting for the steward to count them.
Su Han was at the end of the queue. He lowered his head and panted violently, his shoulders trembling under the weight of forty pounds.
In front of the crowd, Brother Biao, the bully from the mining area, was leaning on a load-bearing pillar, tossing a few coins in his hand out of boredom.
Brother Biao glanced at Su Han from the corner of his right eye.
His facial muscles twitched. His right foot subconsciously took half a step back.
Yesterday's warning from top supervisor Feng Yuan was like a guillotine hanging above the head. Brother Biao knew that the madman in front of him who only had mining in his mind was now the "best coolie" in Feng Yuan's eyes. Touching him would touch Feng Yuan's wallet.
Brother Biao spat hard, turned his head and forcibly looked away, pretending he didn't see Su Han.
The mining team moved forward slowly.
Finally it was Su Han's turn.
He smashed the three cloth bags and the big package wrapped in rags onto the wooden table where the mine was handed over.
"Bang!"
The dull loud noise shook the wooden table. The counting steward behind the wooden desk was startled and almost dropped the brush in his hand to the ground.
"Be gentle! Do you want to smash my stall?" the steward yelled.
When the steward unwrapped the package and saw the mountains of high-quality hematite inside, the cursing stopped abruptly.
His eyes widened. His mouth was slightly open, and he couldn't spit out a word for a long time.
"Forty pounds. All of them are fine red ore.. "The steward swallowed and looked at Su Han up and down with monster eyes.
